name: rhino-mcp
description: Drive Rhino 3D and Grasshopper from Claude: model, inspect, script, and build definitions in your own copy of Rhino.

rhino_version.title: Rhino version
rhino_version.description: Which installed Rhino to launch and connect to.

startup_timeout.title: Rhino startup timeout (seconds)
startup_timeout.description: How long to wait for Rhino to launch and become ready. Raise this on slow machines or when a license or EULA dialog needs clearing.

rhino_8_location.title: Custom Rhino 8 location
rhino_8_location.description: Advanced. Launch a specific Rhino 8 build instead of the installed one. Point to Rhino.exe (Windows) or the Rhino app bundle, e.g. Rhino 8.app (macOS). Leave blank to use the installed Rhino 8.

rhino_9_location.title: Custom Rhino 9 / WIP location
rhino_9_location.description: Advanced. Launch a specific Rhino 9 or WIP build instead of the installed one; both use this setting. Point to Rhino.exe (Windows) or the Rhino app bundle (macOS). Leave blank to use the installed Rhino.
